eva (Rivera): Hey Redwood, Rivera wants a 3-week joint POC. Needs: sandbox tenant, SAML SSO, BYOK (CMEK), and a brief pricing note for ~500k tokens/month. Also ask: can you push request-level traces into our Splunk instance?
maya: Hi Eva 013 we can do sandbox + SAML. BYOK via CMEK on Dedicated or Private. Need Rivera's KMS project details. I'll own pricing.
sam: Splunk: we support forwarding traces via an HTTPS collector or Syslog. We won't send raw request bodies by default; we can forward headers and trace ids. Is that acceptable?
eva (Rivera): They want headers + trace ids only. No bodies. GDPR residency needed in eu-central for logs.
dana: Security checklist for pilot: SOC2 snapshot, signed DPA, retention policy, and confirmation of CMEK flow. Pilot can proceed with signed DPA and SOC2.
maya: Pricing ballpark for 500k tokens/mo posted: hosted est=$Y/month, Dedicated commit est=$Z/month. I'll send formal quote by Thu.
sam: Ops: I'll provision a small GPU pool in eu-central and enable per-api-key quotas. ETA if we get SAML metadata by Tue: Thu tenant ready.
eva (Rivera): Uploading SAML metadata and DPA: https://files.rivera.example/saml.xml and https://files.rivera.example/dpa.pdf
ops-bot: Tenant creation queued: "rivera-sandbox-euc" job id 99421.
dana: Quick BYOK note: for CMEK we'll need a service account with encrypt/decrypt permissions. I'll add steps to the onboarding doc.
maya: Next actions: Maya -> formal quote (Thu), Sam -> tenant + quotas (Thu), Dana -> security checklist + BYOK steps (Wed). Eva -> confirm KMS project and contact (today).
eva (Rivera): Confirmed. KMS project Rivera-KMS-eu and contact secops@rivera.example. Thanks team!
